info.title: OHM Backend API - Root and Tenant
info.description: Requests are grouped by schema. Public / Shared needs no account. Root / Super Admin uses a public-schema token and omits X-Tenant. Tenant Workspace uses a tenant token and X-Tenant: {{tenantSlug}}. Tenant Owner Portal uses a platform-schema tenant-owner token and omits X-Tenant. List endpoints use page=1 and page_size=20 by default; page_size accepts values up to 100. Authentication uses 15-minute access tokens, rotating refresh tokens, and revocable server-side sessions. The Settings folders cover profile, email verification, appearance, notifications, and sessions. Quote requests include GSTIN lookup, form metadata, line discounts/UOM, freight and packing GST, seller tax settings, and filter/search/order examples.
